name: Atheist
ability: The Storyteller can break the game rules, and if executed, good wins, even if you are dead. [No evil characters]
setup: No evil characters: remove all Minions and Demons and replace them with Townsfolk or Outsiders to match the player count.
interaction: None. Any living player may nominate the Storyteller; if the Storyteller is executed, good wins.
drunk_or_poisoned: Only the setup effect matters. If the 'Atheist' is actually the Drunk, there is no Atheist and evil is in play; executing the Storyteller then makes evil win.

rulings.text: The Storyteller may break rules only to give false info or simulate absent evil characters; never invent arbitrary rules or change win conditions.
If no Atheist is in play and the Storyteller is executed, evil wins.
Good loses if only two players are alive.
Night order numbers are from the bra1n townsquare roles.json; 0 there is recorded as null.

test_scenarios.name: execute-storyteller
test_scenarios.setup: 7 players, Atheist in play, all good.
test_scenarios.actions: Day 2: a player nominates the Storyteller; 4 of 7 living players vote.
test_scenarios.expected: The Storyteller is executed; good wins.

test_scenarios.name: dead-atheist-still-wins
test_scenarios.actions: Day 3: the Storyteller is nominated and executed.
test_scenarios.expected: Good wins although the Atheist is dead.

test_scenarios.name: no-atheist
test_scenarios.setup: The Drunk believes they are the Atheist; Imp in play.
test_scenarios.actions: The Storyteller is nominated and executed.

test_scenarios.name: two-alive
test_scenarios.setup: Atheist game reaches two living players without executing the Storyteller.
